name: aflw2000
source: http://www.cbsr.ia.ac.cn/users/xiangyuzhu/projects/3DDFA/Database/AFLW2000-3D.zip (3DDFA project page, Zhu et al., 'Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution', CVPR 2016); downloaded 2026-10-08
license: RESEARCH-ONLY / NON-COMMERCIAL (flag). The 3DDFA page states no licence of its own. AFLW2000-3D = 3DMM fits of the first 2000 images of AFLW (TU Graz), which was distributed only under a signed agreement for non-commercial research; the original AFLW page (lrs.icg.tugraz.at/research/aflw/) is offline (404 on 2026-10-08), so its exact wording could not be re-read. Use for benchmarking only.
notes: Only AFLW2000/image*.jpg + image*.mat were extracted (the zip's MATLAB Code/ folder was not). .mat: Pose_Para = [pitch, yaw, roll, tx, ty, tz, scale] (radians; 3DDFA convention: yaw > 0 = nose toward image LEFT, so §0 yaw = -yaw; pitch > 0 up and roll > 0 clockwise already match), pt2d = 21 AFLW landmarks with missing points coded as (-1, 452) (1718/2000 files have missing points; the official 6DRepNet/Hopenet crop takes min/max over them anyway), pt3d_68 = 68 fitted landmarks (x, y, z). Standard test list: all |angle| <= 99 deg (6DRepNet create_filename_list.py) -> 1969 images.
